name: LPBonus
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.
rootCause: reserve inconsistency between reward accrual and LP withdrawal lets a manipulated MSN reserve inflate an LP reward claim. Lost: ~92,607 USDT (~$92.6k) on BNB Chain; one LP position claimed 1,442,165.713011 FIST against an accrual that funded ~940,041.612768 FIST, extracted by flash-swapping the MSN reserve down at accrual and back up at withdrawal
